texts.arguments: 2. On the other hand, Mr. B. Dutta, learned Senior counsel, assisted by Mr. S. Deka, learned counsel has submitted that this matter has become infructuous, inasmuch as, this appeal has been filed by the appellant, impugning an order of interim injunction dated 04.11.2023. The learned senior counsel submits that though no stay has been granted in this appeal, however, due to pendency, this appeal, may impact the disposal of the Misc(J) Case No. 283/2023, by the trial Court. He also submits that next date of the said Misc Case is fixed on 18.03.2026.
